1. A system for analysing risk associated with an investment portfolio of an investor, said system including means for use in generating user interface for display on a user terminal, said user interface showing a distribution of assets of each investment of the investment portfolio over one or more asset classes and showing the distribution of assets over said one or more asset classes of a benchmark risk category representing a risk tolerance level of the investor, further comprising means for adding an investment to the investment portfolio and means for removing an investment from the investment portfolio. (Currently amended)

4. A system for managing an investment portfolio of an investor, said system including the system for analysing claimed in any one of claims 1 to 3 and including means for adding an investment to the investment portfolio. (Original)

5. A system for managing an investment portfolio of an investor, said system including the system for analysing claimed in any one of claims 1 to 3 and including means for removing an investment from the investment portfolio. (Original)
